axis_note: canonical RAS+ axis: 0=R, 1=A, 2=S. IXI T1 is sagittal-stored, so the native 1.2 mm thick-slice (through-plane) direction is R -> axis 0. Do NOT default to S/Z.
filter_note: gaussian = SMORE slice-profile anti-aliasing (half-power at Nyquist/r); box = ideal sinc truncation (demonstrates ringing); fermi = smooth anti-ringing window.

metrics.mask_method: HR > 0.01 * P99.9(HR), then 3x3x3 binary erosion x2
metrics.data_range: reference HR foreground (max - min) within mask
